recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E 切片中為混合性浸潤：大量小淋巴球與淡染、核呈腎形或新月形的組織球，夾雜免疫母細胞與散在的核碎裂碎屑，且幾乎沒有嗜中性球或嗜酸性球，符合菊池病（Kikuchi lymphadenitis）增生期。
features: Paracortical-type mixed infiltrate of small lymphocytes, histiocytes, and immunoblasts
Histiocytes with pale cytoplasm and indented, crescentic, or twisted nuclei
Scattered apoptotic bodies and karyorrhectic debris without confluent necrosis
Absence of neutrophils, eosinophils, and granulomas
Scattered plasmacytoid-appearing cells and small vessels in the background
describe_en: Section of lymph node shows a paracortical mixed infiltrate of small lymphocytes, immunoblasts, and numerous histiocytes with pale cytoplasm and crescentic or indented nuclei. Scattered apoptotic bodies and karyorrhectic debris are present without confluent necrosis at this field, and neutrophils and eosinophils are notably absent. No granulomas or sheets of atypical large cells are identified. Findings are consistent with histiocytic necrotizing lymphadenitis (Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease), proliferative phase; immunostains (CD68/MPO-positive histiocytes, CD8-predominant T cells) and lupus serology are recommended.

ddx.vs: Shows cytologically atypical medium to large T cells with loss of pan-T antigens and clonal TCR rearrangement rather than a mixed histiocyte-rich infiltrate.
Similar pattern but with hematoxylin bodies, more plasma cells, and positive ANA/anti-dsDNA serology.
Immunoblast-like cells form sheets of CD20-positive large B cells, unlike the scattered immunoblasts here.
Shows stellate necrotizing granulomas with central neutrophils (microabscesses) and Bartonella on Warthin-Starry stain or PCR.
